findings:
🟡 [readme-mcp-health-pre-channel] MUST-FIX `hooks/README.md` mcp-health row claims "Advisories on both PreToolUse and PostToolUseFailure also reach the model via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext", but the PreToolUse unhealthy path in `hooks/mcp-health.js` still exits 2 with stderr only (correctly, per spec §3 which lists only the PostToolUseFailure line); the row contradicts the new "Hook Output Channels" section and P3's acceptance ("which channel reaches the model"). Impact: misdocuments the deny channel for a hook this change touched. Smallest fix: reword to "The PostToolUseFailure advisory reaches the model via `additionalContext`; the PreToolUse unhealthy path remains an exit-2 deny."
🟡 [advisory-queue-rmw-race] CUT/FOLLOW-UP All three group-S writers do an unconditional read-modify-write (append, read, re-serialize, tmp+rename) even when no cap trim occurred; two Stop hooks on the same session (default-on cost-tracker plus opt-in check-console/batch-format run concurrently by the host) can interleave so one appended line is dropped by the other's rename. Loss is rare and best-effort, so it does not block; smallest hardening is to rewrite only when an eviction or truncation actually changed `qents`, keeping the common path pure O_APPEND as §3 intends.
🔵 [single-entry-truncate-quadratic] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The single-entry >8 KiB truncation loop re-serializes the whole entry per removed character; a pre-existing multi-hundred-KB entry in a tampered/corrupt queue would stall the Stop hook. Unreachable from the hooks' own bounded texts (MAX_REPORT, 500-char prettier slice, MAX_ERROR_LINES), so excluded; a byte-slice via `Buffer.from(t).subarray(0, budget)` would make it O(1).
🔵 [section5-unlisted-suites-untouched] CUT/FOLLOW-UP §5 named `hooks/context-budget.test.js:157-161,552-558` and `hooks/tests/reload-watch-detects-mtime-change.test.sh:31` as pinning assertions but the diff does not touch them; if those lines assert empty stdout on the T1/reload advisory path they are now red. Cannot be verified from the diff alone; the landing step's full `run.sh --parallel 8` (already mandated) must confirm, so not blocking here.
🔵 [oeg-test-extra-assertions] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `hooks/orchestrator-edit-gate.test.js` gains `assert.strictEqual(r.stdout, '')` on two exit-2 deny cases (~:413, ~:452) outside the §5-listed :460-465 range. They only tighten KR3 invariants and loosen nothing, so treated as acceptable; name them in the commit per §2.5.
🔵 [test-runner-trailing-newline-strip] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `hooks/test-runner.js` strips `\n+$` while every other group-T hook strips a single `\n$`; when captured test output ends with a blank line the advisory loses that trailing blank line relative to stderr. Whitespace only, no wording change, and the suite's `$(cat)` capture already normalizes it; excluded as cosmetic.
🔵 [cost-tracker-duplicated-text] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `hooks/cost-tracker.js` builds the advisory string twice (stderr template literal and `qtext`) rather than once; currently byte-identical and covered by the suite's byte-identity assertion, so excluded, but deriving both from one const would prevent future drift.
